justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/FixedValue.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/FixedValueTest.java`. `ForOriginType` is a nested, protected helper created only by `FixedValue.originType()`; repo-wide search found just one production call site (`FixedValue.originType()` in `FixedValue.java`) and one test usage (`testOriginType` in `FixedValueTest.java`). Its outgoing dependencies are limited to the surrounding bytecode-assignment helpers (`Assigner`, `TypeDescription`, `ByteCodeAppender`, `MethodVisitor`, `ClassConstant`), with no evidence of broad fan-in/fan-out typical of a hub.
